note: Both sets cover all nine Table 5-1 properties with accurate values and supporting quotes, but A repeats the rated rotor speed three times while B duplicates it only twice. B also binds the brake time constant to the High-Speed Shaft Brake (A misbinds it to the High-Speed Shaft) and keeps the 'fully-deployed' condition on the brake torque, which A drops. A's only advantage is naming the generator speed attribute more explicitly, which does not offset its extra redundancy and misbinding.
